name: Confluencia
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: Malbec and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine area in Neuquén, Argentina. Malbec leads plantings at 40%, followed by Pinot Noir (16%) and Chardonnay (9%).
